notes.title: Patch Notes: December 4, 2023 - Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, added a couple of nice to have features in today.
[list]
[*] Steam Cloud saving is up and working.
[*] You can now disable all dialog in the settings menu.
[*] You can instantly restart the level by pressing back on the controller or backspace on the keyboard.  Feel free to rebind.
[*] You can now move between subscribed workshop levels with the next button.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes: December 1, 2023
notes.content: Fixed a bug where you couldn't see leaderboards if you weren't subscribed to any workshop levels.

notes.title: Patch Notes: November 30, 2023
notes.content:
In this update we've made a step towards Cloud Saves.  Sadly this means that the old save files won't work anymore.

If you want to retrieve maps from the old save system, you can opt into the branch called "oldbuild20231121".

This update also made some minor changes:
[list]
[*]Menus now make little clicky sounds as you move around
[*]Level one leaderboard should now be working
[*]Workshop leaderboards should be working again
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes: November 21, 2023
notes.content:
Finally fixed the leaderboards!  Whew!

There are three new levels that have been added to smooth out the new player experience which introduce ice, crates, and tentacles.

The leaderboard contest ends on Saturday.  Have fun!

notes.title: Patch Notes: November 16, 2023
notes.content:
Hey everyone, this has been a great release week.  Thank you all for playing!
This is a small patch to address some of the issues I've seen so far.  More patches are on the way.

[list]
[*]Reworked the leaderboard system so it should fail to upload less often.  If it fails to upload it will try again.
[*]Treasure Room now uses the Steam Leaderboards to calculate score instead of local score data.
[*]Added 3 new levels to smooth out the experience for new players:
[list]
[*] Introduction to Crate
[*] Introduction to Ice
[*] Introduction to Kraken Tentacle Backswing
[/list]
[*]Camera doesn't follow Captain Silva as he plummets beneath the water.
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: New Graphics and Workshop Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

First of all I want to thank you for playing. Even though the game is still small, some of you have taken the time to involve yourself with the community, and for that you have my deepest appreciation.

With this update I've put a "Good Enough" stamp on two major aspects of the game: Graphics and Workshop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43838838/ffebf4a9b886c80bfe5bf0f16d7ddcbe53378c47.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43838838/fc3d454554e5784c0df06cfcde57e9b8f40deb96.png[/img]

There is still work to be done in these categories: improving animations, improving lighting, creating a tutorial for build mode, etc.

For now, though, I'll be moving on to another major segment: Story.

The objectives for this will include:
[list]
[*] Improving the existing dialog system that's currently used for tutorials.
[*] Setting up models to be shown in the dialog system.
[*] Setting up animations for characters to emote.
[*] Exposing the dialog system to the workshop for creators to make their own content.
[*] Skippable dialog and turning dialog off in the settings.
[/list]

I'm hoping to create a light story with minimal dialog, something that doesn't interrupt play too heavily but still gives context for what's happening in the puzzles.

That's all for now,
LimeBlossom
